column2: ASH-SHARQ: DESERT COMMAND  —  UNIT STAT SHEET  v0.2
Nine-faction balance workbook for the design / programming team. Pair with GDD v0.1 + v0.2 addendum.
HOW THIS FILE WORKS
Yellow cells with BLUE numbers are INPUTS. Change those. Everything black is a formula — do not type over it.
01_ASSUMPTIONS holds the global knobs (veterancy, armour multipliers, intercept chances). Change a knob, the Units sheet updates.
02_UNITS is the live roster. Filter by Faction or Wave. Derived columns (DPS, Cost/HP, Combat Index) recalculate.
03_STRUCTURES is production and defence buildings. Power and build-radius live here.
04_COUNTERS is class-vs-class expected damage multipliers. Used by Combat Index.
05_FACTION_COMPARE rolls the roster up so you can see if Saudi air is actually better than Egypt air.
06_WAVE_PLAN is the ship order from the GDD. Do not art Wave 3 before Wave 0 is fun.
07_CHANGELOG is empty on purpose. Date every stat edit. If you do not, the next pass will fight you.
SCALE
Numbers are RA3-family, not milsim. A rifle squad is ~150 credits / 120 HP. An MBT is ~1500 / 1100. A match is 12–25 minutes.
Damage is ‘per volley’ against that armour class. DPS = Volley ÷ ROF_sec. Combat Index is a designer heuristic, not gospel.
Wave 0 slice units are tagged WAVE0. Those must be tuned first. Everything else is a placeholder that should feel right, not final.
COLOUR KEY
Blue text + yellow fill = input (you edit).  Black text = formula.  Green text on COMPARE = pulled from UNITS.
RULES OF THE FENCE
No nuclear weapons. No living politicians as units. Do not give Egypt an F-35, Iran an Abrams, Pakistan a Rafale, Israel a T-90.
If a matchup sits at 70/30 after a week of play, change COST or BUILD TIME first, identity second, HP last.
